note: machine-dependent: regenerate with `swift run domo-vectors` on this machine  PROTOCOL BREAK 2026-08-21 (deliberate, tightening): every profile now ends with a deny of file-read*/file-write* on Plow Latch's own home (DOMO_HOME) AND on the sibling homes beside it (the Plow-Latch/Plow-Latch-<branch> family, one per checkout, each signed in for its own relay credential — matched both beside this run's home and under ~/Library/Application Support, so a run pointed elsewhere by DOMO_HOME still cannot read the packaged install's), followed by a re-allow of the run's scratch directory. SBPL is last-match-wins, so the deny beats the broad (subpath home) read that previously exposed settings.json — the relay credential and the agentPurpose the reviewer reads as the owner's own words — to every sandboxed command. The scratch directory is granted ONCE, by that re-allow: the earlier duplicate grant went with the same change.
